paragraphs: AI: "Doing last-minute research for voting? Be careful with AI chatbots." (The Washington Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Google Will Turn Off Search for Schools That Reject A.I." (The New York Times).

Political: "Karen Bass takes Election Day swipe at Nithya Raman with embarrassing blooper reel" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Oklahoma man charged with mailing hundreds of letters containing powder to officials ahead of the election" (New York Post).
Economic: "Trump’s tariff claims need evidence, not a rubber stamp" (The Hill) leads the coverage. Also notable: "When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive" (NPR).

Financial: "JPMorgan’s Michele Urges Treasury to Ax ‘Orphan’ 20-Year Bond" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Binance Was Hacked. What Protections Exist for Crypto Customers?" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "Poland Beefs Up Security at Border With Russia" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Seven planes across Europe searched or diverted after ‘malicious hoax’ bomb threats" (The Guardian).
